name: @optima-compliance/rules
description: Crowd-maintained US business compliance rule packs. Every rule cites its statute.
author: StoneDogCode L.L.C.
//publishConfig: A scoped package defaults to RESTRICTED, which fails on a free account with a misleading 402. Set here rather than relying on `--access public` at the command line, so the flag cannot be forgotten by whoever publishes next.
//version: Date-versioned YYYY.M.PATCH, not semver. This is data; it changes when a legislature does. A SCHEMA change is what bumps rule.v1.json to v2, and v1 rules keep working.
